message.content: The pain started two days ago right between my shoulder blades. It doesn't really radiate anywhere else. I don't know how to describe the feeling, but it just started on its own. I didn't have any trauma, heavy lifting, or anything like that happen before it began, and I haven't noticed that moving or coughing makes it any worse. I just know it's been getting harder to stand since then.
